## 🐛 Fixed

- 1.3.0's flag-emoji rule overclaimed "renders as a real flag glyph on every modern OS" - verified on Windows and that's wrong: Windows renders the same regional-indicator codepoints as a compact two-letter tag instead of a pictorial flag, a deliberate long-standing Microsoft emoji-font policy, not a rendering bug. macOS, Linux, iOS and Android do show the actual flag. Corrected the claim in both `docs/design-language.md` and `reference/flagEmoji.ts`'s own comment - the mechanism and the recommendation are unchanged, only the "every OS" wording was inaccurate.
